name: Atlas Cloud
short: Unified OpenAI-compatible API spanning 300+ image, video, audio, 3D and LLM models at transparent pay-as-you-go rates, with free credits to start and no subscription required.

plans.name: Free credits
plans.notes: Free credits to start on signup; no subscription required, one OpenAI-compatible key across the catalog.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Transparent per-request pricing across 300+ models, e.g. video from $0.02/second and image from $0.004/generation; 99.99% uptime target.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Vendor support and infrastructure options for high-volume production use.
